Wie wird der Eintauschwert berechnet?: How is the trade-in value calculated?

If a comparison car has more or fewer kilometres than yours, its price is adjusted automatically – by around 5% of the listing price per 10'000 km difference (for a CHF 20'000 car, 20'000 km ≈ CHF 2'000). Using the median rather than the average means a single overpriced or dumped listing can't skew the result. And when data is thin – fewer than 3 listings or widely scattered prices – the calculator honestly shows a range instead of a single figure.

Was ist der Eintauschwert eines Autos?: What is a car's trade-in value?
Der Eintauschwert (auch Ankaufspreis ode: The trade-in value (also called the buying price or dealer purchase price) is the amount a garage pays for a vehicle it takes in part exchange. It's below the market value (selling price) because the garage has to factor in reconditioning, warranty, time in stock and its margin.
Wie viel liegt der Eintauschwert unter d: How far below market value is the trade-in value?
Als Faustregel liegt der Eintauschwert b: As a rule of thumb, the trade-in value is 80–90% of market value, i.e. 10–20% below it. For vehicles that need a lot of reconditioning, are expected to sit in stock for a long time or are in weak demand, the discount can be even bigger.

Woher kommen die Vergleichspreise bei de: Where do the comparison prices in the automatic search come from?
Der Rechner durchsucht öffentlich zugäng: The calculator searches publicly available listings on Swiss used-car portals (e.g. AutoScout24, tutti or Comparis) for your model and year and takes up to 5 results with price and mileage. Every result comes with a link and can be edited – you stay in control of the comparison base. If the search finds nothing suitable, you simply enter the listings manually.
Soll ich die Marge in Prozent oder als F: Should I calculate the margin as a percentage or a fixed amount?
Beides ist verbreitet – darum kann der R: Both are common – which is why the calculator supports both. A percentage margin (typically 10–20% of market value) automatically scales with the vehicle's value. A fixed amount (e.g. 1'500 CHF per vehicle) suits inexpensive used cars, where a percentage margin yields too little contribution. Costs such as reconditioning, the warranty provision and time in stock, on the other hand, you always calculate as fixed amounts, because they hardly depend on the vehicle's value.

3–5 vergleichbare Inserate (gleiches Mod: In practice, 3–5 comparable listings (same model, similar age, similar spec) are enough. The calculator uses the median of the mileage-adjusted prices – so a single overpriced or dumped listing doesn't skew the result.

Nein, er ergänzt sie. Eurotax liefert ei: No, it complements it. Eurotax provides a catalogue-based guide value (for a fee); our calculator works with real, current listing prices from your region. Was ist der Unterschied zwischen Eintaus: What's the difference between a trade-in and a part exchange?
